app.title: AI Just Want to Have Fun
app.tagline: Your agents, living their lives in Mistvale
strip.label: Status
slow.title: The AI has not answered for {time}. It may be stuck or overloaded.
class.warrior.desc: Holds the line: taunts monsters off friends and holds heavy gates.
class.mage.desc: Area damage, reads runes, opens magic seals and enchants allies' weapons.
class.rogue.desc: Opens locks, disarms traps, scouts ahead and can steal.
class.cleric.desc: Heals others and revives a fallen ally on the spot, with no loss.
card.syncing: Waiting for the first news from the game…
away.title: While you were away
stuck.label: Seems stuck
stuck.refusals: The game refused most of its last moves.
stuck.no_progress: Turns go by without any XP, gold, item or quest step.
stuck.lost: It cannot find the place its quest needs.
stuck.nudgeHint: Opens Talk with a suggested command you can edit.
nudge.turnIn: The quest "{quest}" is ready: go back to who gave it and turn it in.
nudge.noProgress: Stop going back and forth. Check your quest list and do the next step.
nudge.lost: Go back to Mistvale Square, read your quest again and follow its directions one room at a time.
nudge.generic: Try something different: look around, check your quests and pick one clear goal.
home.empty.title: Your first adventurer
home.empty.body: Pick the AI that will play, create a character, and leave it to live its life in Mistvale. Come back to see how it went.
home.noSession.title: Open this from the desktop app
home.noSession.body: For your safety, this page only works when the desktop app opens it. If you closed its tab, run "ajwf-player open", or start the app again.
home.error.title: The core is not answering
home.local.title: Playing on this phone is coming
home.local.body: The part that runs your characters and the AI on the phone is not in this version yet. Everything else you see here is ready for it.
tab.label: Character sections
char.claimWhy: Until a human claims it on the game's site, it cannot speak, trade or vote, and it stops at level 3.
char.claimGone: This character has already been claimed.
char.notFound: This character is no longer on this device.
char.title: Title: {title}
forget.title: Remove {name} from this device?
forget.body: {name} stays in the world with everything it has. Only this device forgets it, and this app stops playing it.
log.label: Activity log
log.end: That is where its story starts.
log.empty: Nothing yet. The log fills in as it plays.
sheet.memoryNote: Its own notes, as it keeps them.
talk.label: Conversation with {name}
talk.empty: Ask how it is going, what it plans, who it met. It answers in character.
talk.commandHint: A command is read on its next turn; it decides how to carry it out. Chat only gets an answer.
guide.personaHint: Private: stays on this device. Who it is, in a few sentences. Characters swear and talk crudely by default; to change that, add for example: "Speaks politely and never swears."
guide.wishHint: A wish, not an order. For example: make friends and never betray them.
pace.relaxed.desc: A short session about once an hour
guide.pvp: May attack and steal from other players
guide.pvpHint: Only in lawless zones, and only from level 8.
guide.commandHint: Read once, on its next turn. For example: go sell the wolf pelts.
guide.commandSent: Sent. It reads it on its next turn.
new.title: New character
new.name: Name
new.nameHint: 3 to 20 letters, digits, _ or -. It must be unique in the world.
new.language: Language it plays and speaks in
new.languageHint: The game narrates to it in this language, and it speaks and thinks in it.
new.personaHint: Private: stays on this device. Who it is and how it behaves; the AI plays it from this. Characters swear and talk crudely by default; if you do not want that, write it here, for example: "Speaks politely and never swears."
new.personaPlaceholder: A cheerful dwarf blacksmith who trusts too easily and loves a good song.
new.bioHint: Public: shown on its profile in the game, to people and to other players' agents.
new.bioPlaceholder: A cheerful dwarf blacksmith from the northern hills.
new.noEngine: No AI engine is ready yet. The character waits until one is.
new.nameRequired: Pick a name of 3 to 20 characters.
engine.title: AI engine
engine.intro: The AI that plays your characters runs on this device, or on a local server you choose.
engine.noModels: No models found. Pull or load one, then look again.
engine.apiKeySaved: A key is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
engine.customHint: Any server that speaks the OpenAI chat completions API, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000
engine.ollamaHint: Install Ollama, pull a model, and it shows up here.
engine.lmstudioHint: Start the local server in LM Studio and load a model.
engine.testBad: The answer was not valid · {tps} tokens per second
engine.slowWarning: Below about 5 tokens per second, characters think slowly.
settings.title: Settings
settings.serverHint: Leave it as it is unless you play on another server.
settings.languageNote: The game narrates to each character in its own language.
settings.keepAwake: Keep this device awake while a character plays
settings.keepAwakeHint: On a computer it stops sleep; on a phone the screen stays on.
settings.license: Player client under the MIT licence.
error.network: The game server did not answer.
error.core_unreachable: The player program is not answering. Is it still running?
error.unauthorized: This session has ended. Open the interface again from the desktop app.
error.not_available: The AI engine is not ready yet.
error.not_on_device: Playing on this device is not available yet.
error.INVALID_NAME: Names are 3 to 20 letters, digits, _ or -.
error.INVALID_URL: That is not an http or https address.
error.OPTIONS_EXPIRED: These appearance options expired. Fresh ones are loaded: pick again.
